# Vendored sim-pool

Last-resort copy of the **sim-pool** lease manager, so `npx sim-eyes` works on a Mac that has never installed the skill.
It is run as `python3 vendor/sim-pool/sim-pool` (npm does not keep file modes), and only when no `SIM_POOL_BIN` and no
installed skill is found.

Do not edit this file here. Change the skill, then copy it over and update the sha256 above.
Lease state lives in `~/.agent-sim-pool` and is shared with the skill's copy, so keep both on the same version.
